title: 1976-09-15_Dorothy_211.txt
concise_summary: PKD synthesizes Buddhist karmic doctrine with Platonic macrocosm-microcosm theory to explain his 2-74 to 3-74 experiences as a phylogenic memory collapse in the individual soul. He argues humans are star-born aliens whose third eye was disabled by environmental toxins on Earth, and that his awakening reveals a latent Renaissance illuminatus (possibly Erasmus) living within his psyche, transmitting Hermetic wisdom and the Logos concept that structures his novel Ubik.
key_claims: Humans are extraterrestrial beings whose pineal/ajna eye atrophied on Earth due to missing infrared light frequencies, until PKD's eye reopened at the 1974 vernal equinox.
The individual human mind contains the entire phylogenic history of the species (and by extension the macrocosm) in latent form, retrievable through anamnesis or triggered trauma.
Thomas, a 2nd-century Christian personality within PKD, recognized a lethal trap pattern from his Roman execution and triggered phylogenic survival skills in PKD's right hemisphere.
A Renaissance humanist (likely Erasmus) achieved immortality through possession of original Christian gnosis and now inhabits PKD's consciousness as a transtemporal matrix personality.
Ubik represents the Logos or world soul (Nous, Holy Wisdom) that deals in information and transcends bipolar dialectical forces.
The macrocosm-microcosm hylozoic model necessitates a universal soul; PKD's Ubik unknowingly encoded this ancient Hermetic/Neoplatonic truth through literary intuition.

evidence_quotes: I remembered coming here to this planet from the stars (sky). Then that's how we got poisoned: we came here + something here debased + sickened + deranged us.

The Macrocosm (universe) - Microcosm (man) theory leads to the interesting idea that any given human mind contains _latently_within_it_ the entire structure or soul of the totality, but in miniature, so _all_ knowledge can be retrieved out of one person's mind through mirror-like "magic recollection" (Bruno).
Or, put another way, my 3-74 (actually 2-74 to 2-75) experience _confirms_ the macro-micro analog system, with the macro's ontogeny _+_ phylogeny retrievable within a man's (mind).

The only real question left is _how_ this could be, these two selves in me, (in my head), one living now + one living in another century. Well, all we have to do is examine the _content_ of the knowledge which this other personality has.

No wonder those marxists wanted to know what Ubik was! The rest was clear to them (the dialectic & the form-regression). But what is Ubik? Do even I know? Not one of the bipolar antithetical forces -- no, it is above them. The world soul, or Noos, or (best yet) Logos -- or Holy Wisdom -- it deals in information (& it does really exist, as I learned beginning with the cereal box messages dream!
